$sources: AISC 360-22 and the AISC Code of Standard Practice (AISC 303) use AWS A2.4 weld symbols; the drilling allowances and the cope clearance are SAEngine practice; see VERIFY.md
source: AWS A2.4 weld symbols (AISC 303 practice); SAEngine practice for the allowances

sources.weldSymbols: AWS A2.4 (the symbols of AISC 303 shop drawings)
sources.anchorHoleClearance: SAEngine practice: rod + 6 mm in the base plate (AISC Design Guide 1 Table 2.3 gives larger holes with plate washers)
sources.copeClearance: SAEngine practice: 10 mm clear of the supporting beam's flange and root
sources.plateGrades: ASTM A992 is a specification for structural shapes only (no plates); a connection with no plate material takes ASTM A572 Grade 50, the plate specification of the same Fy 345 / Fu 450 MPa the design used (AISC Manual Table 2-4, applicable ASTM specifications for plates and bars)
